lead.headline: Taylor managed 6.7 Thursday, and Tuten's only cover locks at noon
lead.deck: Limited Wednesday, DNP Thursday. If he misses Friday too or is listed doubtful, start Rice before 12:00.
lead.body: Bad news first: Jonathan Taylor scored 6.7 against 16.6 projected Thursday night: 11 carries for 21 yards and 4 catches as Houston beat Indianapolis 26-3. The Colts' quarterback was reportedly benched, and no injury was reported for Taylor. Bhayshul Tuten did not practise Thursday after a limited Wednesday, Marks and Jacobs cannot play, and Rice and Odunze kick off at 12:00, so nobody can replace Tuten at Jacksonville's 13:55 inactives. The rule: if he misses Friday's practice too, or is listed doubtful or out, start Rice in FLEX before noon. Otherwise start Tuten. You lead KEI returns 6.7 to 6.5.
